description: Time zones: the IANA zone of every country, and of the admin units where zone lines cross a country (datasets/timezones), as a `tz` column on each pack's own admin layers, with the few hand-drawn areas in its `timezones` layer.

world.name: placewise curated datasets: time zones (datasets/timezones)
world.notes: Curated by the placewise project and licensed CC BY 4.0 (datasets/LICENSE.md in the placewise-data repository): the IANA zone of each country, admin-1 unit, county or census subdivision, with the tz database (public domain), 49 CFR Part 71 (public domain) and the provincial acts cited per entry, and a few hand-drawn areas (Eucla, the western Aleutians, research stations). The outlines in the packs are the units' own boundaries, so they are also credited to the boundary source. Zone names are checked against the tz database at build time.
